question: What salutation is offered to Kāmeśvarī as support of the universe and great illusion?
premises: Kāmeśvarī is addressed as support of the universe
Kāmeśvarī is addressed as great illusion
inference: The speaker offers reverent salutation to Kāmeśvarī in these forms.
plain_english: O support of the universe, great Māyā, Kāmeśvarī, obeisance to you.
